name: assessments_team_capabilities
description: The caller's team as one set of capabilities, one role at a time: each capability's score is the mean of everyone's score on it against their own level, as a percentage (100 is the team meeting it on average), with how many were scored and how many are short. gaps lists capabilities where more than half are short. people is direct (direct reports, the default) or below (everyone below the caller); ratings is manager (the default), self or aligned. Only people whose score has unlocked count: scored is those in view, scored_on_role those at any level of the role. compare is level (the default) or none: with level, each capability's group_median is everyone on the role at the team's levels, team included, from the level comparison's latest snapshot of agreed ratings (taken every 1, 3 or 6 months, as the tenant chooses), weighted by how many of the team are at each level; comparison.taken_on says when it was taken. Without a line, comparison.reason says why: none (compare is none), off (the tenant has comparisons turned off), no_snapshot, or too_few with the short_levels under min_group_size. Nothing names anyone on the team.
